name: whatsapp
title: WhatsApp (official)
description: The access token, app secret and public webhook URL of a WhatsApp Cloud API channel.
needed_for: Lets a WhatsApp data source send and receive messages on your number.
justification: The access token sends messages through Meta's Cloud API, the app secret proves an incoming webhook really came from Meta, and the public webhook URL is where Meta delivers messages.

FLOW_WHATSAPP_TOKEN.label: Access token
FLOW_WHATSAPP_TOKEN.hint: WhatsApp → API Setup → Generate access token (test), or a System User token that never expires (production).

FLOW_WHATSAPP_SECRET.label: App secret
FLOW_WHATSAPP_SECRET.hint: App settings → Basic → App secret (Show). Verifies each incoming message.

FLOW_WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_URL.label: Public webhook URL
FLOW_WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_URL.hint: Made by the setup: the URL Flowpad cloud holds for this computer. Meta posts messages to it.
